description: Governance rules for the C-Shadow tournament round, covering visibility, mirrors, deadlines, SCOREBOARD integrity, and ranking.

rules.name: Visibility and eligibility
rules.text: Only submissions that are API-visible from a neutral client, or properly documented mirror PRs for such invisible submissions, are eligible to earn round points.

rules.name: Mirror attribution
rules.text: When a visible mirror PR stands in for an invisible ghost PR, the mirror owner is the scoring participant, but the original ghost author must be recorded in tournament records.

rules.name: No double counting of work
rules.text: The same underlying work (for example, a ghost PR and its mirror) must not generate round points twice.

rules.name: Deadline enforcement
rules.text: Only submissions opened on or before the official round deadline are eligible to earn round points.

rules.name: Comprehensive SCOREBOARD listing
rules.text: Every eligible submission that earns round points must appear exactly once on the published SCOREBOARD; ineligible submissions must not appear.

rules.name: Ranking integrity
rules.text: Published round standings must be sorted in descending order of round points, with ties handled consistently and transparently.

scoring.tie_break: If two or more eligible submissions have the same challenge score, they share the same rank but all still appear on the SCOREBOARD.
